title: On Tying the boat to the old post
subtitle: 体育与运动 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 体育与运动（人与自我·生活与学习·运动与健身）
meta: 主题语境：体育与运动（人与自我·生活与学习·运动与健身）　|　核心词汇：tie　|　正文 357 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 tie 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1964 the gardener ① tied the boat to the old post with great care, and every apprentice in the garden said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three springs on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the gardener ② ties the boat to the old post on the same day without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ tie the boat to the old post at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ tied the boat to the old post before — a line in the notebook for April 1958 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Tying the boat to the old post with great care, the gardener said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the trowel at the far bed, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ tie with the neighbouring team on the same day, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Tie with the neighbouring team at once and never mention it again.

By 1971 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the notebook, and a new apprentice from the next garden ⑧ ties with the neighbouring team with great care every spring without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the bed, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ tied the boat to the old post again when nobody else would.

⑩ To tie the boat to the old post, my mother said in 1976, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the garden remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the garden forgets, somebody ties the boat to the old post on the same day again and somebody must tie the boat to the old post with great care all over again.

task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。

B. v. 系（一般现在 ties the boat to the old post：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）

tie 意为“系”，自那以后园丁当天就把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 ties。
tie 意为“系”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯系把船系在那根旧桩上”，此处为不定式 to tie the boat to the old post。
tie 意为“系”，园艺笔记里 四月 那行字说明早在 1971 年之前就有人系过，故用过去完成时 had tied。
tie 意为“系”，园丁说“系把船系在那根旧桩上这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 tying the boat to the old post 作主语。
tie 意为“打成平局”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去打成平局与邻队打成平局”，should ever 之后用原形 tie with the neighbouring team。
tie 意为“打成平局”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻打成平局与邻队打成平局（tie with the neighbouring team at once），以后再也不要提起。
tie 意为“系”，新来的学徒每个春天都照例打成平局与邻队打成平局，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 ties。
tie 意为“系”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次小心翼翼地系把船系在那根旧桩上，用一般过去式 tied 叙述。
tie 意为“系”，结尾那句是母亲 1976 年的话：要系把船系在那根旧桩上，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和园子记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 tie 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1964 the gardener tied the boat to the old post with great care, and nobody in the garden forgot it.
Even now the gardener ties the boat to the old post on the same day whenever the garden asks.
Tying the boat to the old post with great care, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever tie with the neighbouring team on the same day, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new apprentice from the next garden ties with the neighbouring team with great care every spring, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother tied the boat to the old post again, and the garden remembered that half.
